name: horologium
description: What time is it in Babylon? Explore 13 calendars in a live, Antikythera-inspired clock, with reference comparisons and explicit historical limits.

study.finding: Chinese dates against HKO: 0 mismatches on 62,821 modern days; 90 historical differences remain. This does not validate all 13 calendars.

name: gnomon
description: Design horizontal, wall, equatorial and analemmatic sundials; export dimensioned SVGs and full-scale PDF construction kits.

study.finding: 26 PDF kits, 192 pages: digital checks cover dimensions, angles and tile seams. Physical printing, assembly and outdoor accuracy remain unverified.

name: planisphere
description: Build a star wheel for your latitude and compare stellar epochs from 3000 BCE to 3000 CE, with printable disc and holder templates.

study.finding: 4,201 historical star positions: 0.04 arcmin robust scatter against the editors' reduction; five high-motion stars differ by 1-19 arcmin.

name: tonemirror
description: Practice speech intonation against recorded Mandarin examples, listen to both clips, and keep credited audio offline in your browser.

study.finding: One attributed Mandarin recording supplies four tone examples. Paired listening preserves selected audio; the shape score is not a pronunciation grade.

name: errorbars
description: Compare LLM evals on recorded task intersections, account for repository clusters, and inspect missing outcomes before ranking.

study.finding: A public SWE-bench file records 441/500 tasks. Removing 59 invented failures changes paired-task p from 0.000060 to 0.644; official score unchanged.

name: contextscope
description: Diagnose prompt-cache misses from captured Anthropic/OpenAI requests and usage; media and stored history retain explicit unknowns.

study.finding: PNG controls: identical pixels became 8,095 or 457,130 estimated Claude tokens; local media counts now stay unavailable.

name: fieldproof
description: Link extracted fields to source words and inspect native PDF paint, clipping and overlap risks before accepting a document claim.

study.finding: 1,052 receipts: strict matching rejects all 2,251 one-letter name mutations in this study, but also sends OCR-repaired names to review.

name: mcplint
description: Lint your MCP server's tools the way the model sees them: token cost, clarity, and hidden instructions.

study.finding: 418 MCP servers: 28 exceed 16,000 estimated tool-definition tokens. On 886 unseen servers, none of five attack-rule errors identified an attack.

name: veil
description: Mask detected personal data and credentials in LLM requests, keep originals in a local vault, and restore them in replies and streams.

study.finding: 16,082 held-out phone numbers with a +: masking rose from 53.9% to 99.3%. International numbers without + remain a detection gap.

name: tracelens
description: Inspect OTLP or Jaeger agent traces locally: compare runs, follow span evidence and reconcile recorded token counts before estimating cost.

study.finding: A controlled SDK span recorded 0 and 1,000,000 input tokens. The viewer retains both and withholds the charge; this is not an invoice.

name: trainspotter
description: Inspect training logs, follow findings to recorded steps, and download annotated vector charts with source and axis context. Works offline.

study.finding: 537 held-out runs ending at their best loss: warnings fell from 73.0% to 6.9%. That endpoint label does not establish that a run was trouble-free.

name: ghostchars
description: See the characters you can't: catch Trojan Source bidi tricks, invisible and lookalike Unicode, and ASCII smuggling in code and LLM prompts.

study.finding: 83,494 public prompts and agent rules: three files contain hidden Unicode payloads, all in one jailbreak repository; this is not an attack-rate estimate.

name: logdelta
description: Diff logs by meaning, not by bytes: masks variables, mines templates, and shows what's new in the failing run.

study.finding: 264 failed Kubernetes builds: excerpts show the recorded reason in 212/239 eligible cases, at 40.5 median lines. The rule was tuned on these logs.

name: flakemap
description: Find the flaky tests in your CI history: JUnit XML or .NET TRX from past runs in, a ranked, statistically honest flake report out.

study.finding: 4,334 Kubernetes builds: 310/314 rechecked package failures passed on the same commit. The data do not separate faulty tests from infrastructure.

name: stutterscope
description: Open native CapFrameX JSON or capture CSVs, select a recording, and inspect frame-time gaps and slow-frame source evidence in your browser.

study.finding: Filtered Intel gold data: 175 retained frames have 83 clock gaps and only 91 observed pacing pairs; missing durations stay unknown.

name: splitscope
description: Private, in-browser LiveSplit analyzer: time save, consistency, reset survival, and Monte Carlo odds of your next PB.

study.finding: 51 speedrun histories: at 50 attempts, the mean PB forecast was 14.3% and observed frequency 30.9%; only nine runners supplied forecasts.

name: am-i-unlucky
description: Drop-rate and pity math with earlier, same-attempt and later finish shares, collection odds, and downloadable luck cards.

study.finding: 26.9M community-logged five-stars: the soft-pity ramp agrees through pull 83 under stated assumptions; incomplete histories bias the odds.
